title: Treasury coupon announcement (2Y + 5Y + 7Y notes, 2Y FRN NEW ISSUE, 13/26/6-week bills) — the January month-end block, whose auctions straddle the 2027-01-26/27 FOMC
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), re-fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) by this event's own initial research, text layer decompressed stream-by-stream and re-tokenised into 213 rows spanning 2026-08-05 to 2027-02-04. SEVEN securities carry `Thursday, January 21, 2027` as their announcement date, read verbatim: `13-Week  BILL` and `26-Week  BILL` (auction Monday, January 25, 2027), `6-Week  BILL` (Tuesday, January 26, 2027), `2-Year  NOTE` (Monday, January 25, 2027), `5-Year  NOTE` (Tuesday, January 26, 2027), `2-Year  FRN` (Wednesday, January 27, 2027) and `7-Year  NOTE` (Thursday, January 28, 2027) — the four coupon/FRN legs all settling Monday, February 01, 2027. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE PROPOSAL THIS FILE REPLACES, both read off the same document: the FRN row carries NO trailing `R`, and the PDF's own legend reads `R --denotes reopening`, so Treasury's own marker makes 2027-01-27 a NEW ISSUE (the sibling 2026-11-19 block's row reads `2-Year  FRN R`); and there is NO 52-Week BILL on this announcement — the 52-week's turn in its strict 28-day cycle falls on the 2027-01-14 announcement (auction Tuesday, January 19, 2027). The ~11:00 a.m. ET announcement time is Treasury convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-09 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md — the id previously existed only as `proposals/treasury-coupon-announcement-2027-01-21.from-treasury-10y-tips-2027-01-21.json`, which was read in full first and is now shadowed. WHAT MAKES THIS INSTANCE DIFFERENT FROM ITS SIBLINGS, all measured in the ledger: (1) the four auctions it sizes STRADDLE AN FOMC MEETING exactly — 2Y Monday 01-25 (decision -2), 5Y Tuesday 01-26 (decision -1, FOMC day one), FRN Wednesday 01-27 (THE DECISION DAY, bidding closing 11:30 a.m. ET against a 2:00 p.m. statement) and 7Y Thursday 01-28 (decision +1), with the 2027-01-26/27 meeting read direct from federalreserve.gov's own FOMC calendar (FED:, HTTP 200); the straddle is measured across 103 decision dates and 404 block auctions since 2015 and is a NULL, if anything mildly positive, which is the opposite sign of the intuitive story. (2) The FRN leg is a $30B NEW ISSUE rather than a $28B reopening — 10 of 10 new issues since 2024-04-24 printed $30B, and sb0590's FRN column reads 30 in new-issue months and 28 in reopening months. (3) With no 52-Week bill, this is the CLEANEST month-end block in the schedule's window: three routine weekly bills plus three notes sitting in sb0590's invariant columns plus an FRN whose size is published in shape. THE HONEST COUNTERWEIGHT, and it is the reason nothing here is more than a deduction: January 2027 is the THIRD and furthest-out month of the 2026-11-04 refunding's window, three months past the last cell sb0590 actually publishes (Oct-26) — the weakest published-guidance position of any month-end block this calendar has researched. Proposed sizes are deductions from a 28-month freeze, never quotations. `symbols: []` and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
